BEMIS Assurance® Modular Raised Toilet Seat System

A premium modular raised toilet seat system customers can build around safety, style, and hygiene.

BEMIS Assurance gives dealers a stronger bath safety story than a standard raised toilet seat. Customers can choose the raised seat, add support arms in silver or black to match their bathroom decor, and upgrade with a bidet designed specifically for the Assurance system — all backed by the Stay·Tite fastening system and a limited lifetime warranty, proudly made in the USA.

Why dealers should pay attention

A premium modular solution, not a one-size-fits-all riser.

Most raised toilet seats are one-size-fits-all, look clinical, and don't address hygiene. Assurance can be built around the customer's bathroom, mobility needs, and hygiene preferences.

Modular retail story

A premium raised toilet seat system customers can customize with silver or black support arms to better match their bathroom decor, and add a great hygiene option in the Bidet for the Assurance series raised toilet seat.

Customizable

Hygiene upgrade option

The Full Line

The Assurance bath safety family — a seat for every customer.

Beyond the flagship Assurance system, Bemis offers a full family of raised and standard-height seats so dealers can match the right level of support to each customer.

3" raised1,000 lbUniversal-Fit
Flagship

Assurance™ with Clean·Shield™

The premium 3-inch raised toilet seat and heart of the modular system. Heavy-duty oversized seat with the Clean·Shield design to keep the toilet cleaner, a larger opening, 12 stabilizing ribs, and non-corroding stainless posts. Lifts for standing and cleaning; fits both round and elongated toilets.

Add-on350 lb / armSilver or black

Assurance™ Support Arms

Fully weight-bearing support arms that add to the Assurance seat. Ergonomic design better supports sitting and standing, 350 lb capacity per arm, available in silver or black to coordinate with the bathroom.

Add-onNon-electricHygiene

Assurance™ Bidet Attachment

A non-electric bidet designed specifically for the Assurance raised seat. A simple twist knob controls the wash, an adjustable T-valve delivers consistent pressure, and the spray angle is tuned to the raised seat height.

Standard height+ arms500 lb

Assist™ + Support Arms

A standard-height premium toilet seat with included support arms — replaces the need for wall- or toilet-mounted rails. Larger opening, Super·Grip bumpers, and self-sustaining check hinges; seat lifts for standing use and cleaning.

4.5" raised+ arms300 lb

Rise™ + Support Arms

A 4.5-inch basic raised toilet seat with support arms — taller height for additional support. Ergonomic design for easier sitting and standing, Easy·Clean removable seat, coverless fixed mount. Ideal for temporary use.

3" raisedOpen-front500 lb

Steadfast™ Open-Front

A 3-inch raised open-front heavy-duty toilet seat — the open front provides easier access. Commercial-grade easy-to-clean plastic, non-corroding stainless posts, Super·Grip bumpers, and self-sustaining check hinges.

Bemis Independence Assurance® with Clean Shield™ Elevated Toilet Seat

Maintain your independence with the Clean Shield Elevated toilet seat! Design blends into your bathroom and the 3-inch riser lets you sit and stand easier. Seat never loosens, giving you stability. Optional support arms can be added as needed for additional support and safety. Also you can add an optional Bidet for Hygiene.

Stay·Tite™ Commercial Fastening System — never loosens. Guaranteed.

Every Assurance and Assist seat installs with the Stay·Tite system: the nut snaps off at the perfect torque, so it can't be over- or under-tightened. A strong, fast, secure fit that never needs re-tightening — backed by a limited lifetime warranty and proudly made in the USA by Bemis, family-owned since 1901.

  • Strong — superior, reinforced, non-corroding hardware
  • Fast — easy, precise installation
  • Secure — never re-tighten the seat again
  • Clean·Shield design helps keep the toilet cleaner
  • Limited lifetime warranty
  • Proudly made in the USA

Modular raised toilet seat system

BEMIS Assurance® Modular Raised Toilet Seat System

A premium elevated toilet seat system that gives customers the safety of a raised seat, the ability to add decor-friendly support arms, and the option to upgrade with a bidet — a stronger premium story than standard bath safety risers. Best customer fits:

  • Seniors wanting to remain independent at home.
  • Post-surgery or rehab customers needing temporary or long-term support.
  • Caregivers looking for a more stable bathroom safety solution.
  • Customers who dislike the look of standard raised toilet seats.
  • Customers who want black or silver arms to coordinate with their bathroom.
  • Customers with hygiene concerns who may benefit from a bidet upgrade.

Training / Video

Installing the Personal Wash Bidet with the Clean Shield Seat

The Assurance® 3" Raised Premium Toilet Seat is designed for both round and elongated toilets, with optional armrests. It connects to your existing toilet and water source, requiring no batteries or electricity. Features include: An ergonomic twist knob for hands-free, thorough cleaning. Adjustable water pressure for comfort and effectiveness, reducing toilet paper usage and skin irritation. A water spray angle tailored for the seat’s higher height. A retractable, self-cleaning bidet nozzle with a quality brass valve and inlet. All parts are included for easy, standard installation. Enjoy a simple, hygienic, and eco-friendly bathroom solution.
